commander_identity.mechanical_plan: Six-mana Missy converts dead nonartifact creatures, including opponents' cards, to stolen tapped 2/2 Cyberman artifacts; reveal-morph cards turn face up into nonartifacts and can die repeatedly to loop through Missy. Cybermen and artifact-entry/death payoffs multiply end-step villainous choices.
commander_identity.natural_ceiling: Power Bracket 4 — Optimized: deterministic Missy-dependent loops, fast acceleration, efficient protection and Grixis interaction, not generic cEDH due to six-mana commander and multi-piece setup.
commander_identity.anti_homogenization: Do not replace Missy's Cyberman conversion and zero-cost morph recurrence with a generic Thoracle/Consult/Breach cEDH core. Retain cards that magnify stolen artifacts and villainous choices.

whole_deck_audit.roles_and_overlaps: Reconciled all 99 current October 15 approved noncommander slots to historical 99-slot audit and reopened slow morph draw, expensive Cyberman top-end, repeated variable-cost edicts/wipes, conditional theft unlock, protection, mana ramp and all 35 lands. Retained the three free-turn-up bodies, six outlets after Carrion Feeder, five core face-down unlock/interaction pieces, artifact-entry and death win conditions, cyberman/villainous package, cheap counter interaction, main tutors and remaining asymmetric kills.
whole_deck_audit.mana_base_and_curve: 35 physical lands before and after. Two checklands and the slow Inventors' Fair metalcraft tutor convert into two additional fetches and Cavern of Souls naming Time Lord for uncounterable Missy. Chrome Mox and Grim Monolith add early acceleration, while 7-mana Squadron and 6-mana Cybership/Their Name Is Death leave; no claim that Cavern fixes non-Time-Lord spells.
whole_deck_audit.interaction_resilience: Retain Offer, Swan Song, Greaves, Boltbender, Willbender, Silencer, Stratus Dancer, Terminate, Feed, Chaos Warp, Cyclonic Rift, Delete, Toxic Deluge, Grave Pact, Plaguecrafter, Accursed Marauder. Add Fierce Guardianship, Deflecting Swat, Gift of Doom and Sharpshooter. Loses one six-mana sweep and variable edict but preserves broad nonartifact death conversion.

whole_deck_audit.current_baseline_strength: October 15 approval was already 16 strategic swaps and had an explicit 99-slot audit, 35 lands, legal Grixis and commander-native zero-reveal morph loops. This pass is a substantive revision that preserves its verified structural and themed core.
whole_deck_audit.candidate_pool_scope: Source 99 audit plus twelve selected replacements; current EDHREC Missy Morph/Upgraded/Optimized candidates; fresh Scryfall 97 selected plus dozens of candidate Oracle records; free outlets, removal, ramp, tutor, lands, themed artifact payoffs, forbidden and generic alternative packages.
whole_deck_audit.off_ranked_search_conclusion: Commander-native off-ranking Altar of Brood, Gift of Doom, Sharpshooter and Yawgmoth outrank several EDHREC high-inclusion but expensive Cybermen; high synergy alone did not dictate selection.

final_changes.coherent_package_tradeoff: Twelve earned replacements cut high-cost attack engines, redundant slow sweep/edict and overlapping face-down support for immediate protection, faster Missy deployment, stronger free sacrifice and nonartifact-death loops, low-cost table kill, repeatable creature removal, and uncounterable/fetchable land sequencing. Keeps meaningful Cyberman/villainous-choice core and multiple morph unlocks.

low_swap_heightened_audit.off_ranked_opportunities: Altar of Brood, Gift of Doom, Goblin Sharpshooter, Yawgmoth, Grim Monolith and land fetches challenged EDHREC top-card selections.

multi_slot_packages.result_and_rationale: Thirteenth/fourteenth speed changes rejected due to land-discard and colorless late-game failures.
Additional generic power sacrifices faster counter and commander-native sac engine, so quality declined.

low_swap_heightened_audit.alternate_cuts_for_prior_holds: The Master, Braids, Shipwreck Marsh, Panoptic Projektor and The Cyber-Controller challenged as possible further removals and retained for unique identity or colored consistency.
low_swap_heightened_audit.strongest_argument_against_baseline: October15 already had robust free reveal morph loops and low-cost staples; replacements that remove too much Cyberman texture could homogenize the deck.
low_swap_heightened_audit.evidence_based_answer: Twelve selected replacements retain Valeyard, Master, Cyber-Controller, Cyberman Patrol, Death in Heaven and the essential face-down infrastructure, while transforming previously slow engines into cheaper native finish, sacrifice and protection.

open_ended_optimization_audit.remaining_99_review: Every noncommander slot checked against October15 whole-list audit and actual current approved source, including retained rare Cyberman payoffs, counterplay, graveyard engines, land sequencing, and competing mana acceleration.

post_floor_challenges.tradeoff: Doubles Missy death-conversion, but removes unique complementary artifact-Cyberman death choice.
Tutor is faster but fewer repeatable sac/draw opportunities.
Occasional pregame colored mana versus persistent UB source reliability.

open_ended_optimization_audit.no_credible_larger_package_reason: Two concrete theoretical 14-replacement packages were examined: adding Mox Diamond and Gemstone Caverns would compromise colored late-game sources and early hand resources, while Mana Drain plus Imperial Seal would displace faster Swan Song and commander-native Braids sacrifice value. No further source-bound full-100 package earned inclusion; the two conceptual tests are not represented as staged, CI-executed lists.
open_ended_optimization_audit.quality_based_stop_reason: The 12 selected changes fix concrete six-mana commander resiliency, sacrifice payoff, speed and land tempo gaps. Additional changes tested exact opportunities and declined rather than stopping at a numerical cap.

final_candidate.deckwide_reconciliation: 100 physical/97 unique/35 lands, only Island2 and Swamp3 duplicated. Twelve actual one-for-one swaps vs October15 approved source, 97 exact-current Scryfall Oracle records official Commander legal, no out-of-Grixis identity.
